name: a1-yandex-kit-skills
description: A1 Yandex KIT Skills: typed client, MCP server and agent skills generated from the official OpenAPI spec

scripts.build: npm run build -w packages/core && npm run build -w packages/mcp
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w packages/core && npm run typecheck -w packages/core && npm run typecheck -w packages/codegen && npm run typecheck -w packages/mcp
scripts.test: npm run test -w packages/core && npm run test -w packages/codegen && npm run test -w packages/mcp && npm run test:setup-skill
scripts.e2e: npm run build && npm run e2e -w packages/mcp
